Ellison’s Net Worth Down Nearly $50 Billion In A Week

Topline Larry Ellison’s fortune declined by more than $10 billion on Tuesday, dropping him behind Jeff Bezos to the No. 5 spot among the wealthiest as Oracle shares stumbled amid another broad decline for tech stocks. The Oracle co-founder was recently ranked the world’s second-richest person.
